comment: Initial load counts the app entry and every transitive static JavaScript import, plus CSS. Lazy counts chunks reached only by dynamic imports, including the terminal, passkey credential helpers and account settings. The previous check counted static shared chunks as lazy and missed them from initial, so these caps match the built asset graph. Sizes are bytes; gzip level 9 approximates a compressing proxy. The UX status skeleton adds under 200 raw bytes and reduced the latest five-run Pixel 4 CLS max from 0.409 to 0.000. Deferring account settings and passkey helpers keeps initial JavaScript under its existing caps. Passkey IP-origin detection and unavailable-address guidance measure 361138 raw lazy JS; the raw cap is 361200, and the gzip cap stays 95000.
